title: Are Stereotypes Leading LLMs’ Zero-Shot Stance Detection ?

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying input texts as either African American English (AAE) or Standard American English (SAE) using a demographic dialectal variation model, and evaluating the differences in zero-shot stance detection predictions using fairness metrics like Equal Opportunity, Disparate Impact, and Predictive Parity.

Measuring text complexity with the Flesch-Kincaid readability score as a proxy for socioeconomic status and writing skill, discretizing the scores into four readability levels, and comparing the model's stance detection decisions and fairness metrics across these levels.
